description_ru: Покупательница возвращает в магазин сломанный ноутбук и обсуждает с продавцом варианты решения.
text:
Elena: Good afternoon. I bought this laptop here three weeks ago, and I'm afraid it has stopped working properly.

Mark: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you tell me what exactly is wrong with it?

Elena: Well, the screen keeps flickering, and yesterday it switched itself off in the middle of an important presentation. I was extremely embarrassed.

Mark: I can imagine. Have you tried updating the software?

Elena: Of course. The technician on your helpline said that the problem would be fixed after the update, but it only got worse.

Mark: Hmm. Do you have the receipt with you?

Elena: Yes, here it is. I was also told that there is a two-year guarantee.

Mark: That's correct. Let me check the system. It says here that the laptop was delivered on the fourth of September, so you are well within the warranty period.

Elena: Good. So what happens now? I'd like a refund, to be honest. I've lost my confidence in this model.

Mark: I understand, but I should explain that refunds are normally only given within fourteen days. After that, we can either repair the device or replace it with a new one.

Elena: Fourteen days? Nobody mentioned that when I bought it. The assistant simply said that I could bring it back whenever I wanted.

Mark: I apologise for the misunderstanding. Let me speak to my manager. Would you mind waiting for a few minutes?

Elena: Not at all. But I'm not leaving without a solution.

Mark: Thank you for your patience. Right, my manager has agreed to make an exception. We can offer you a full refund, or a better model for the same price.

Elena: A better model? That sounds more reasonable. Is it as light as this one?

Mark: It's even lighter, and the battery lasts twice as long. Shall I bring one so that you can try it?

Elena: Yes, please. If it works as well as you say, I'll take it.

Mark: Wonderful. Give me a moment, and I'll be right back.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы вперёд, как для «у», и быстро раскройте их; зубы не касаются губы, иначе получится «в».
Кончик языка слегка просуньте между зубами и выдохните без голоса; не заменяйте звук на «с» или «з».
Кончик языка не касается нёба и не вибрирует; оттяните язык назад и слегка округлите губы.
Кончик языка упирается в дёсны, а задняя часть языка поднята к нёбу; звук твёрдый, как в «ол», без смягчения.

questions.question: How long ago did Elena buy the laptop?
What is wrong with the screen?
Within how many days are refunds normally given?
What does Mark offer in the end?
questions.answer: A full refund or a better model.
